games.desc:
Scream Jam re-uploaded: https://www.roblox.com/games/121848455085269/Scream-Jam#!/about

The Scream Jam reupload will continue to be updated as frequently as before, so don't worry, your game progress will be preserved in the original version of Scream Jam. 

What Scream Jam is right now is solely for testing the characters. In the future, it will have mechanics that will set it apart.

 The game is in a very early alpha stage, so it's very unstable. 
Expect to find errors and bugs, in addition to very questionable balance. 

--NOTHING YOU SEE IN THE GAME IS THE FINAL PRODUCT-- 

This game isn't trying to look retro (trust me). Another asymmetrical horror game trying to achieve something more.

Using exploits will result in a permanent ban (I don't know who would do that, honestly). 

Primarily inspired by Die of Death (you should try that too!).
